description:
Three years into marriage, the life I believed to be perfect crumbled. Myojin's husband, always kind and gentle. That husband was in a hotel with a young female employee on their wedding anniversary. Peaceful daily life collapsed in an instant due to her husband's affair, and in front of Myojin, who was enduring the pain alone, her husband's most trusted old friend, Seong-eul, appears. Without hiding his dangerous gaze towards his friend's wife…
